info.title: Channel dashboard — live API only
info.rule: If this file and the catalog disagree, this file wins. Do not call forbidden paths. Do not mock them.

headers.Authorization: Bearer {token} — required except POST /channel/auth/* and GET /health
headers.Accept-Language: ignored — server messages are English; map error.code in the UI
headers.X-Idempotency-Key: UUID per user intent on every write except OTP/login. request-otp is NOT idempotent.
headers.X-Channel-Id: do not send — ignored for channel users

envelope.money: integer minor units except GET/POST /channel/zones (decimal strings)
envelope.sort: never send sort — silently ignored and drops default order
envelope.not_found: 404 means missing OR not yours — never render forbidden
